response.justification: Bogdan far exceeds the software development experience bar (15+ years) and has genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth — he authored a test runner (Trial) and an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built test automation and Selenium curricula, ran CI/CD and GitLab/Docker infrastructure, and taught workshops. However, the resume shows no explicit people-management track record: no direct reports, no performance/one-on-one ownership, and no organizational-change leadership, which are core to this Level II Manager role. Titles are consistently IC (Senior/Staff Engineer), and the founder role at GISCollective reads as a solo/open-source project rather than team leadership. Mobile-platform exposure exists (iOS/Apple TV, device orchestration) but is dated and secondary. Worth a screening call to probe informal leadership, mentoring scope, and management intent — but he is likely a step short of the people-leadership minimum.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tools and test-infrastructure work (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, Selenium)
15+ years across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded with strong system design breadth
Proven mentoring/teaching via workshops, dojos, and multi-module courses
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports
No evidence of roadmap ownership or leading organizational change
Mobile-platform experience is limited and roughly a decade old

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure depth
